description: Search this tenant's messages, or list the most recent ones when query is omitted (the way to check for new mail). Returns up to limit message summaries (id, thread_id, direction, from_addr, to_addrs, subject, sent_at/received_at), newest first; use get_message for bodies. mode keyword matches words in subject and body, semantic finds messages by meaning, hybrid combines both.

inbox_id.description: Optional: restrict results to one inbox.

query.description: Search text. Omit to list the most recent messages.

name: search_messages
title: Search messages
